findings.subject: Unknown-artifact diagnostic detail
findings.body: The thrown error `'unknown-artifact'` is not very actionable when this fails in CI logs. Include the actual `$ArtifactId` value and the allowed keys (e.g., `($DestinationMap.Keys -join ', ')`) so failures can be diagnosed without re-running under a debugger.

findings.subject: Recovery child current-working-directory contract
findings.body: The recovery harness launches Node with a relative script path, which will fail if the working directory isn’t the repository root (e.g., if the script is invoked from a different cwd in future callers). Prefer building an absolute path from `$PSScriptRoot` (and/or setting `ProcessStartInfo.WorkingDirectory`) so the invocation is cwd-independent.

findings.subject: Generator harness cleanup masks primary error
findings.body: The unconditional `Remove-Item` in `finally` can mask the original test failure if cleanup fails (e.g., due to transient file locks or partial directory deletion). To keep CI diagnostics stable, guard cleanup with `Test-Path` and avoid throwing on deletion failure (reserve throws for the containment check).

findings.subject: Inline acquisition/proof factoring
findings.body: The acquisition/proof logic is embedded as large inline `run:` blocks and (from this diff) is substantially duplicated across the platform generator jobs. This increases the risk of platforms drifting unintentionally and makes review harder. Consider moving these scripts into versioned `.ps1` helpers (invoked with parameters like expected host / git path) so the workflow only wires inputs/outputs.
